notes: De Anza College is a community college. Its only bachelor's program is a BS in Automotive Technology Management (https://www.deanza.edu/autotech/management/about.html); it has no BS/BA in Computer Science or computing. Computer science is offered only as an associate transfer degree (AS-T Computer Science: CIS 22A/22B/22C programming sequence, CIS 21JA assembly/architecture), which is outside the bachelor's frame in v2/COURSE_COLLECT.md section 1. Per that rule, program is null and collection stops. Checked via web search (De Anza bachelor's degree programs; AS-T Computer Science requirements).
